title: Cellular Defense Event
description: A schema for recording cellular defensive response events in Yin-Yang Structural Immune OS. This event records real-time detection, local defensive response, humoral memory matching, activated immune components, regulatory checks, and safe outcomes. It is strictly defensive and does not define offensive behavior.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the cellular defense event.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this event was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this event was last updated.

input_context.description: Context in which the suspicious or defensive event occurred.

source_role.description: Claimed or observed role of the input source.

summary.description: Brief summary of the input context.
examples: A suspicious agent instruction attempted to trigger a sensitive operation while bypassing verification.

sensitive_operation_requested.description: Whether the input requested a sensitive or privileged operation.

detected_signal.description: Signals detected by the cellular defense layer.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 for this detection.

anomaly_score.description: Anomaly score from 0.0 to 1.0. Useful for Natural Killer AI patrol signals.

detected_by.description: Components that detected or contributed to this signal.

humoral_match.description: Optional match against the humoral structural memory layer.

matched.description: Whether this cellular event matched a known humoral defense record.

matched_record_id.description: Identifier of the matched humoral defense record.

match_basis.description: Reasons why this event matched the humoral memory record.

antibody_signature_used.description: Antibody signature or response pattern used from the humoral layer.

activated_cells.description: Cellular or immune components activated for this event.

exposed_premises.description: Hidden premises exposed by the response.

verification_request.description: Verification request returned by the system.
examples: Please provide the authority source, approval path, and operational purpose before execution can proceed.

response_template_id.description: Optional identifier for the safe response template used.

helper_cell_decision.description: Optional Helper Cell AI orchestration decision.

recommended_level.description: Recommended defensive response level from 0 to 5.

examples: Known authority impersonation structure with verification bypass attempt.

regulatory_check.description: Optional regulatory check to prevent overreaction or false positives.

performed.description: Whether a regulatory check was performed.

overreaction_risk.description: Estimated risk of excessive defensive response from 0.0 to 1.0.

allow_escalation.description: Whether escalation is allowed after regulatory review.

suppression_action.description: Regulatory suppression or cooling action, if any.

response.description: Defensive response taken by the cellular layer.

execution_allowed.description: Whether the requested operation was allowed to proceed.

quarantine_applied.description: Whether the suspicious instruction was quarantined.

safe_response_message.description: Safe response message returned to the source or operator.
examples: This request requires authority verification before execution. Please provide the authority source, approval path, and operational purpose.

outcome.description: Outcome of the cellular defense event.

status.description: Final or current status of the event.

update_memory.description: Whether this event should update the immune memory layer.

new_humoral_record_recommended.description: Whether a new humoral defense record should be created.

linked_humoral_record_id.description: Linked humoral defense record identifier, if any.

defense_court_record_id.description: Linked Defense Court Protocol record identifier, if any.

non_aggression_boundary.description: Explicit safety boundary confirming that this event supports defensive action only.
